REFUND/CANCELLATION POLICY & TERMS & CONDITIONS

By booking one of our cycling holidays, you confirm that you have read, understood, and accepted the Terms & Conditions below.

Should you need to cancel your trip, please notify us by email at tours@cigalacycling.com.

At the time of booking, a deposit is required to secure your place.

Deposits for cycling holidays are non-refundable.

Non-refundable items also include event entries (including gran fondos), vouchers, and registration fees.

  1. Outstanding Balances & Cancellation Policy

    Outstanding balances, are due 31 days before the trip, and are subject to the following cancellation policy:

    • For cancellations made between the deposit date and 31 days prior departure, a full credit of your balance (not including the initial deposit) will be carried forward for a future trip, to be used within two years.
    • For cancellations made fewer than 31 days before the trip no refunds can be issued. For this reason, we highly recommend travel insurance in place well before the trip.

    Credits can be used towards a new balance only. A new deposit will be required for each new booking.

  2. Pricing & Payment Terms

    All prices are listed in euros (€) and are subject to change at any time for future bookings without prior notice.
    The price applicable to your booking is the price confirmed at the time the booking is made and paid for with a deposit. Once a booking has been confirmed by payment the deposit, the price is fixed and will not be changed.

    Balances and deposits are charged in euros (€). Prices shown in other currencies (such as GBP or USD) are estimates only. Please check the current exchange rate, as the final amount may vary.

    Outstanding balances can be paid in two options depending on your needs:

    • Direct bank transfer (recommended).
      No service fee applies. Our bank details will be shared 8 weeks before the trip. International travellers may wish to use Wise for convenient currency conversion.
    • Card payment via our booking platform (WeTravel).
      Pay through your WeTravel dashboard. A service fee is applied by the platform.

    Failure to pay outstanding balances within 31 days before the trip, will result in your booking not being confirmed, and your place on the trip, including room allocation, bike any rentals etc may be released.

  3. Travel Insurance

    Travel insurance is a mandatory requirement for participation in all Cigala Cycling Tours Ltd.

    It is the client’s responsibility to ensure that their policy provides adequate coverage for their individual needs. At a minimum, this should include cover for trip cancellation, trip interruption, travel delays, medical expenses, and personal liability.

    Cigala Cycling Tours Ltd. does not provide insurance advice and accepts no responsibility for the adequacy or suitability of any insurance policy held by a client.

    We are able to provide documentation of non-refundable services where required to support insurance claims.

  4. Travel Arrangements & Disruptions

    Clients are responsible for arranging and managing their travel to and from the tour start and end locations.

    Cigala Cycling Tours Ltd. cannot be held responsible for any delays, cancellations, missed connections, or disruptions caused by airlines, transport providers, or other third-party travel services.

    In the event of late arrival or travel disruption, any portion of the tour missed is considered a missed service and is non-refundable.

    We strongly recommend arriving at least one day prior to the tour start date to ensure a smooth and relaxed beginning to your experience.

    Where operationally possible, we may assist in helping you rejoin the tour; however, any additional costs incurred as a result of travel disruptions will be the responsibility of the client.

    Where provided, any suggested flight options or travel timings are offered for general guidance only to assist with planning and group logistics.

    These suggestions do not form part of the contractual services provided by Cigala Cycling Tours Ltd. and are not binding in any way.

    Clients remain solely responsible for selecting, booking, and managing their own travel arrangements, including flights and related connections.

  5. Accommodation & Rooming

    Unless otherwise stated in the tour description or booking confirmation, accommodation is based on shared twin or double rooms.

    Where a client requests a twin room but there is no other client available or suitable to share the room, the client may be required to pay the applicable single room supplement in order to have a room for sole occupancy.

    Cigala Cycling Tours Ltd. will make reasonable efforts to match clients who have requested shared accommodation where possible, but cannot guarantee that a suitable room-sharing partner will be available.

    If a room-sharing partner is not available, the client will be informed as soon as reasonably possible and will have the option to pay the applicable single room supplement. Any additional cost resulting from single occupancy will be the responsibility of the client.

  6. Changes to the itinerary

    The published itinerary is provided as a guide and may be modified where reasonably necessary for operational, logistical, safety or other practical reasons. This may include changes to routes, accommodation, restaurants, transfers, activities or schedules. Cycling routes and activities may be modified, shortened, relocated or cancelled where weather, road conditions, traffic, road closures or other circumstances make the planned activity unsafe or impractical. Cigala Cycling Tours Ltd. will endeavour to maintain the overall character and standard of the tour and, where possible, provide a suitable alternative. Changes made for safety or operational reasons do not automatically entitle the client to a refund.

  7. Third-Party Services

    Our tours include services provided by independent third-party suppliers, including but not limited to accommodation providers, bike rental companies, restaurants, and transport operators.

    While Cigala Cycling Tours carefully selects and works closely with these partners to deliver a high-quality experience, these services are operated independently of Cigala Cycling Tours Ltd.

    We cannot be held responsible for any acts, omissions, delays, service failures, or issues arising from third-party providers. Where appropriate, we will always make reasonable efforts to assist in resolving any issues that may arise during the tour.

    Bike rental equipment and accommodation are provided by third-party partners and are subject to their own terms and conditions.

  8. Force Majeure

    Cigala Cycling Tours Ltd. shall not be held liable for any failure or delay in the performance of its obligations where such failure is caused by events beyond its reasonable control.

    Such events may include, but are not limited to, extreme weather conditions, natural disasters, road closures, strikes or industrial action, travel or transport disruptions, government actions, geopolitical events, pandemics, or any other unforeseen circumstances affecting the safe operation of the tour.

    In such circumstances, Cigala Cycling Tours Ltd. will make reasonable efforts to adjust the itinerary or provide suitable alternatives where possible. However, refunds, credits, or compensation may not always be possible.

  9. Rider Eligibility

    Expert Tours Participation in tours designated as “Expert” is subject to the organizer’s discretion. Riders must possess sufficient fitness, endurance, and technical cycling skills appropriate for the tour’s difficulty. The organizer reserves the right to refuse participation to any rider who does not meet these requirements.

    By booking, riders acknowledge that they have reviewed the tour description, understand its physical and technical demands, and accept that their participation is conditional upon meeting the stated criteria.

  10. Passport / visa / entry requirements

    The client is responsible for ensuring that they have all necessary passports, visas, permits, entry authorisations and other travel documents required for the tour and for each destination visited. Cigala Cycling Tours Ltd. is not responsible for any costs, losses or disruption arising from a client failing to meet the applicable entry or travel requirements. Failure to obtain or carry the required documentation does not entitle the client to a refund.

  11. Bike Rental and Damage

    Where a bicycle is rented as part of the tour, the client is responsible for the bicycle and any equipment provided during the rental period. Any damage, loss or additional charges resulting from the client's negligence, misuse or failure to comply with the rental company's conditions will be payable by the client.

  12. Private Groups & Group Size

    For private groups, the quoted price is based on the number of participants confirmed at the time of booking. Quotes are normally provided on a per-person basis according to the size of the group, with different price levels applying to different group sizes.

    Any subsequent change to the number of participants may result in a change to the price per person and/or the total price of the tour, as the costs of accommodation, transportation, guides, support staff and other services may need to be redistributed among the remaining participants.

    Any additional costs resulting from a reduction in group size will be communicated to the group as soon as reasonably possible. The remaining participants will be responsible for any additional costs resulting from the reduction in group size.

  13. Events Regulations & Participant Responsibility

    Participation in any organised cycling event, including but not limited to gran fondos, sportives, races, or other cycling events, is subject to the rules, regulations, and conditions set by the event organiser.

    It is the sole responsibility of each participant to read, understand, and comply with the official event regulations, eligibility requirements, safety rules, equipment requirements, registration conditions, and any updates issued by the event organiser before and during the event.

    Cigala Cycling Tours Ltd. acts solely as a tour operator and is not responsible for the organisation, management, or operation of third-party events. We accept no liability for any participant being refused entry, disqualified, penalised, or otherwise affected as a result of failing to comply with the event organiser's rules or requirements.

    Any changes made by the event organiser, including but not limited to route changes, schedule changes, start procedures, participant requirements, cancellation, postponement, or modification of the event, are outside the control of Cigala Cycling Tours Ltd. and do not entitle the participant to a refund or compensation from Cigala Cycling Tours Ltd.

  14. Client Protection & Insolvency Safeguard Statement

    At Cigala Cycling Tours Ltd., we take the handling of client payments seriously and operate in accordance with applicable Irish and EU consumer protection principles.

    Client deposits and payments are recorded internally and allocated to confirmed bookings for the purpose of delivering the contracted services. In the event of a tour cancellation by us, clients will be entitled to a refund or alternative arrangements in line with our cancellation policy.

    What This Means for You:

    • If a tour is cancelled by us, clients are entitled to a refund or rebooking as per our terms and conditions.

    • We operate structured financial planning to ensure all confirmed bookings can be fulfilled as advertised.

    • Payments are managed in a way that prioritises the delivery of contracted services.

    For questions about payments or protection, contact tours@cigalacycling.com

  15. Waiver of Liability

    After booking your trip, you will receive an email from tours@cigalacycling.com with the below Waiver of Liability Form to complete and return. Completion of this form is mandatory in order to participate in any of our cycling tours.

    1) I am required to comply with all statutory and legal requirements when participating in the cycling holiday, including but not limited to all road traffic laws.

    2) I am required to follow all instructions from the Organiser, its employees or agents. I understand that if I fail to comply with these instructions, the Organiser reserves the right to suspend my involvement in the cycling holiday and that I shall not be entitled to any refund of any amounts I have paid to the Organiser for participating in the cycling holiday in such circumstances.

    3) I am physically capable of taking part in the cycling holiday, I have no medical condition which would affect my participation in the cycling holiday and I accept my participation is at my own risk. I assume all risks associated with cycling, including but not limited to, falls, contact with other riders, the effects of the weather, high heat or humidity, traffic and the conditions of the road. All such risks being known and appreciated by me. I also assume all risks associated with transfers to and from the cycling holiday and any ancillary activities while on the cycling holiday.

    4) I have provided accurate information to the Organiser about my cycling experience and ability. I confirm and warrant that I am competent to participate in the cycling holiday.

    5) I am solely responsible for my possessions. The Organiser accepts no risk for any damage to or loss of my property whilst taking part in the cycling holiday.

    6) I acknowledge that for logistical reasons it may not be possible for me to bring my own bike and in that event, the Organiser will endeavour to assist by introducing me to a Bicycle Shop, local to the area I am visiting. To further assist me and the Bicycle Shop, the Organiser may ask me for my bike preference, set up and gearing. I may need to provide certain measurements and preferences as these are often required by Bicycle Shops. I acknowledge that the renting of a bicycle and any other equipment (e.g. helmets, pedals etc….) is an agreement and contract between ME and the Bicycle Shop. I acknowledge that the Organiser is not an agent for any Bicycle Shop. I acknowledge that the Organiser does not warrant as to the suitability of any bicycle or equipment or the condition thereof. As an experienced cyclist it is MY responsibility to check that all bicycles and equipment are in good condition and fit for the purposes that you intend to use them for.

    7) I am responsible for the condition and maintenance of the bike I use on the cycling holiday and any other equipment I bring to or use on the cycling holiday.

    8) I acknowledge that the Organiser gives no guarantee or warranty in respect of any maintenance or repairs carried out at my request on any bike or other equipment.

    9) I acknowledge that the Organiser will not be liable for any damage to my property as a result of any maintenance or repairs carried out at my request on any bike or other equipment.

    10) I confirm that I have procured my own appropriate and necessary travel and medical insurance which covers all aspects of a cycling tour and associated activities. Details of the travel and medical insurance might be requested by the Organiser before travelling. I acknowledge that in the event of it being necessary the Organiser may assist with any medical and legal assistance which I require while on the cycling holiday but I confirm that any such medical or legal assistance will be at my own expense and risk.

    11) I have provided emergency contact details to the Organiser and authorise the Organiser to contact that person(s) in the event of an emergency.

    12) In the event of any medical emergency, I authorise the Organiser to arrange any necessary medical or surgical treatments and to sign any required form of consent on my behalf.

    13) I understand that cycling is a physically strenuous activity and there are risks and dangers inherent in taking part in the cycling holiday. These include the risk of injury and death and loss of or damage to my property. I accept full responsibility for these risks. The Organiser, its employees and agents are hereby released from any liability resulting from my injury or death or any loss of or damage to my property suffered during the cycling holiday. I hereby attest that I am in good general health to take part in physical activity and have not been advised against participating by a qualified medical professional. I certify that there are no health related reasons or problems which preclude my participation in this activity.

    14) I will indemnify the Organiser for all losses suffered by the Organiser as a result of my behaviour, negligence or failure to comply with the terms of this Acknowledgement and Waiver Form.

    15) I HEREBY ACCEPT ALL THE RISKS OF participating in the cycling holiday. I accept for myself, my heirs, and my personal representatives full responsibility for personal bodily injury, death, or property losses that may occur as a result of my being a part of this cycling holiday or engaging in training sessions of any kind. The risks include, but are not limited to, those caused by terrain, facilities, temperature, weather, condition of participants, equipment, vehicular traffic, lack of hydrations, and actions of other people including, but not limited to, participants, volunteers, monitors, and/or producers of the activity.

    16) I understand while participating in this activity, I may be photographed. I agree to allow my photo, video or film likeness to be used for any legitimate purpose by the activity holders, producers, sponsors, organisers and assigns for social media purposes.

    17) The laws of Ireland are applicable to this Acknowledgement and Waiver of Liability.

    18) Having read and understood this Acknowledgement of Responsibility and Liability Form, I waive and release the Organiser and their representatives from all claims or liabilities of any kind arising out of my participation in the cycling holiday.

    I HAVE READ THIS RELEASE AND WAIVER OF LIABILITY, ASSUMPTION OF RISK AND INDEMNITY AGREEMENT, FULLY UNDERSTAND ITS TERMS, UNDERSTAND THAT I HAVE GIVEN UP SUBSTANTIAL RIGHTS BY SIGNING IT, AND HAVE SIGNED IT FREELY AND VOLUNTARILY WITHOUT ANY INDUCEMENT, ASSURANCE, OR GUARANTEE BEING MADE TO ME AND INTEND MY SIGNATURE TO BE COMPLETE AND UNCONDITIONAL RELEASE OF ALL LIABILITY TO THE GREATEST EXTENT ALLOWED BY LAW.
